name: Trust and Company Service Provider Misuse
description: Misuse of trust and company service providers, including formation agents and nominee or registered-office services, to create, administer or obscure companies and trusts used for laundering. TCSPs may be witting, negligent or exploited.

sources.text: FATF and Egmont Group, Concealment of Beneficial Ownership (2018)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for Trust and Company Service Providers (2019)
FATF, Money Laundering Using Trust and Company Service Providers (2010)

indicators.name: Bulk company formation for undisclosed clients
indicators.canon: Bulk company formation for undisclosed clients
indicators.desc: TCSP forms large numbers of entities with little client information.
indicators.ctx: TCSP forms large numbers of entities with little client information.

indicators.name: Nominee services without disclosure of principal
indicators.desc: Registered directors or shareholders appear to act for undisclosed principals, serve many entities or have no real decision-making role.
indicators.ctx: Nominee directors or shareholders with no record of beneficial owner.

indicators.name: Introduced customers with no direct contact
indicators.canon: Introduced customers with no direct contact
indicators.desc: Client business introduced through TCSP with no face-to-face contact and little data.
indicators.ctx: Client business introduced through TCSP with no face-to-face contact and little data.

indicators.name: Structures lack commercial rationale
indicators.canon: Complex layered structure without commercial rationale
indicators.desc: Multiple tiers of entities, trusts or foundations, often across secrecy or low-transparency jurisdictions, with no evident business or tax reason.

indicators.name: Registered address or mailbox shared by many entities
indicators.canon: Registered address shared by many entities
indicators.desc: Customer shares a registered address, mailbox, agent or phone with numerous unrelated companies, such as a mass-registration or virtual office.
indicators.ctx: Same address serves numerous unrelated entities.

indicators.name: Frequent changes of directors, names or owners
indicators.canon: Frequent changes of customer or entity details
indicators.desc: Customer or entity repeatedly changes name, address, contact details, directors, signatories or ownership.

indicators.name: Bank accounts opened or operated by TCSP staff
indicators.canon: Bank accounts opened or operated by TCSP staff
indicators.desc: TCSP is signatory or conduit for client funds.
indicators.ctx: TCSP is signatory or conduit for client funds.

indicators.name: Reluctance to provide beneficial owner information
indicators.canon: Reluctance to disclose beneficial ownership or control
indicators.desc: Customer or intermediary is vague, delayed or inconsistent when asked who owns, controls or ultimately benefits from an account, entity or funds.
indicators.ctx: TCSP resists or delays beneficial ownership details.

indicators.name: Activity in secrecy jurisdictions without links
indicators.desc: Entities, accounts or assets are booked in jurisdictions offering strong secrecy or limited transparency, including where unrelated to the entity's operations.
indicators.ctx: Entity uses secrecy jurisdictions unrelated to operations.
